speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The frequency of checks takes into account complaints received from the public.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I filed this Parliamentary Question on behalf of quite a number of my residents who are affected by this phenomenon.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: But I truly appreciate the good groundwork by our ground partners, such as the Neighbourhood Police Posts from Rochor, Marina Bay and Kampong Java and also agencies like NEA.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: But they seemed to be quite constrained in their work on the ground and I wonder if MHA and other relevant agencies can review and take more effective upstream measures to contain this noise disamenity that comes as a result of night entertainment operators, such as ensuring that before allowing operating, that soundproofing and other measures are put in place first and that the decibel limits are actually looked into, whether it is really effective, that it does not affect the residents, such as restricting or disallowing licences in residential zones and also perhaps studying and granting the Police and agencies like NEA and LTA more power to enforce more effective measures against the errant operators.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: I would also like to thank the Member for working with our agencies in managing some of these issues.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: When we hear of such feedback, we will enhance the enforcement and work together as well with the operators.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We will continue to work with the Member and we will see how we can manage these together and, at the same time, bring all the agencies together to help address the issues.
